# apple_win_back_offer (Resource)

Defines a win-back offer, which App Store Connect shows to lapsed subscribers who meet its eligibility rules. The offer's identity, terms and prices can't change, so changing them replaces the offer; eligibility, dates, priority and promotion change in place. Destroying the resource deletes the offer. Import it with `<subscription_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_win_back_offer" "come_back" {
  subscription_id                  = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  reference_name                   = "Come back"
  offer_id                         = "come_back"
  offer_mode                       = "FREE_TRIAL"
  duration                         = "ONE_MONTH"
  period_count                     = 1
  paid_subscription_months         = 3
  months_since_last_subscribed_min = 2
  months_since_last_subscribed_max = 12
  start_date                       = "2026-12-01"
  priority                         = "NORMAL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (String) Length of each offer period: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS`, `ONE_YEAR`.
- `months_since_last_subscribed_min` (Number) Fewest months since the customer's subscription lapsed.
- `offer_id` (String) Identifier of the offer, unique in the app, e.g. `come_back_50`.
- `offer_mode` (String) Kind of offer: `FREE_TRIAL`, `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a discounted price each period) or `PAY_UP_FRONT` (one discounted price for all periods).
- `paid_subscription_months` (Number) Months a customer must have paid for the subscription to be eligible.
- `period_count` (Number) Number of offer periods.
- `priority` (String) Priority over other win-back offers: `HIGH`, `NORMAL`.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name of the offer.
- `start_date` (String) First day of the offer, e.g. `2026-12-01`.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

### Optional

- `end_date` (String) Last day of the offer. Unset means no end.
- `months_since_last_subscribed_max` (Number) Most months since the customer's subscription lapsed. Unset means no limit.
- `plan_type` (String) Plan the offer is for: `UPFRONT` for the whole period at once, `MONTHLY` for a yearly plan billed monthly. Defaults to `UPFRONT`.
- `prices` (Attributes Set) Prices of a paid offer, one per territory. A free trial has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))
- `promotion_intent` (String) Whether the App Store promotes the offer: `NOT_PROMOTED`, `USE_AUTO_GENERATED_ASSETS`.
- `wait_between_offers_months` (Number) Months a customer waits after one win-back offer before another.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer.

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Required:

- `price_point_id` (String) Price point of the offer in the territory; see `data.apple_subscription_price_points`.
- `territory` (String) Territory, e.g. `USA`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_win_back_offer.come_back
  identity = {
    subscription_id = "6446452616"
    id              = "9876543210"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_win_back_offer.come_back 6446452616/9876543210
```
